title: Slovakian Cheese and Potato Soup
description: A hearty, comforting soup originating from Slovakia, made with cheese, potatoes, and a touch of paprika.
instructions: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add diced potatoes, grated cheese, flour, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Gradually add chicken broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill if desired.
